# [CS021] Weak Cipher or Static Nonce (crypto-weak-cipher)

DES, RC4, ECB mode or a constant nonce or IV is used.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-327](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/327.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

DES and RC4 are broken, ECB leaks patterns of the plaintext, and reusing a nonce with GCM reveals the XOR of plaintexts and allows forgeries. Use AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 with a random nonce per message.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
nonce := make([]byte, 12) // all zero, reused for every message
ct := aead.Seal(nil, nonce, plaintext, nil)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
nonce := make([]byte, aead.NonceSize())
if _, err := rand.Read(nonce); err != nil {
	return err
}
ct := aead.Seal(nonce, nonce, plaintext, nil)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [crypto-weak-cipher]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    crypto-weak-cipher: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore crypto-weak-cipher -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** crypto-weak-cipher
```
